text:
maria: Heads-up — preparing MPT-30B-v2 weights for serving. Need final weights path, tokenizer note, and quant decision (AWQ vs GPTQ vs FP8) for the dedicated canary. Planning to run calibration on ~8k samples; canary is targeted for tomorrow morning. Who can own signoff?

kai: I can own weights handoff. Uploading to s3://redwood-models/mpt30b-v2/sha-9b8c7d. Also question: do we use the fused tokenizer from tokenizer-service_v2? We saw occasional missing BOS for shorter prompts in evals.

sam: I pulled the weights and verified checksums. Path confirmed. Noted tokenizer vocab quirk: two special tokens got swapped (pad vs mask). We should patch tokenizer.json before serving. Quick patch: ```json
{"special_tokens_map": {"<pad>":50256, "<mask>":50257}}
```

anya: For calibration, 8k is borderline — prefer 10k to reduce variance. From prior runs: 8k -> ±0.7% top1 delta; 10k -> ±0.3%. AWQ tends to give bigger memory/throughput wins (40–50%) but ~0.6–1.0% accuracy hit vs fp16. GPTQ is closer to fp16 (0.2–0.4% hit) but slower and larger. FP8 is promising but we need to validate numeric stability on longer context.

maria: Target perf: p50 <= 120ms, and cost delta <1.5x. If AWQ keeps accuracy within 1.0% of fp16, prefer AWQ for cost. FP8 only if it passes accuracy + stability checks.

kai: Quick local smoke results: AWQ -> 0.9% sac drop vs fp16, GPTQ -> 0.3% drop. AWQ memory reduction ~45%, GPTQ ~35%. I'll kick off AWQ canary + calibration with 10k samples now.

ops-bot: Canary job created: canary/mpt30b-v2/awq/2026-03-18-08:00, job id c-7842. Link: https://deploy/jobs/c-7842 :rocket:

sam: Tokenizer fix pushed to repo: commit 3f4a2e. Patch applied: ```json
{"special_tokens_map": {"<pad>":50256, "<mask>":50257}}
``` Please ensure serving config points at tokenizer_service_v2.

anya: Calibration config I'm proposing:
```yaml
calib:
  dataset: s3://redwood-calib/mpt30b/10k
  metric: ppl
  batch_size: 64
  warmup: 100
  eval_split: qa-small
```
We'll run perplexity + a small QA eval to catch regressions in generation.

maria: Gate criteria for rollout: 1) perf targets met (p50/p95), 2) ppl delta <= 1.0% vs fp16 on calib set, 3) zero tokenizer mismatch errors in canary logs for 24h. If all met, I sign off for Dedicated canary -> gradual rollout.

kai: Agreed. Uploading canary logs to /shared/canary_logs/c-7842 as it runs. ETA ~3h for full calib pass. I'll update this thread with numeric results.

anya: I'll monitor accuracy and QA eval; will post final numbers to this thread.

sam: Small serving tweak: enabling kv_cache_prefetch improved p50 by ~8% in staging. Add to serving config: `kv_cache_prefetch: true`.

maria: Thanks all — please ping here if any blockers. :thumbsup:
